en.issues.blocking: Can't start an execution from the app
en.issue.no_src.title: src/ folder not found
en.issue.no_src.detail: The project doesn't follow the team's standard structure, so there's no entry point the app can run.
en.issue.src_empty.title: src/ folder is empty
en.issue.src_empty.detail: The bot doesn't have Python code yet. It may still be pending migration to the standard.
en.issue.no_main.title: src/main.py not found
en.issue.no_main.detail: The app only runs bots with src/main.py orchestrated by Pipeline. This project has other scripts ({scripts}){launcher}, so it runs outside the app.
en.issue.no_group_log.title: GROUP_LOG not found
en.issue.no_group_log.detail: Couldn't read which {watch} folder it writes its logs to. The app will look in {watch}/{name}; if that's wrong, you won't see live logs.
en.issue.no_progress.title: Progress bar won't be shown
en.issue.no_progress.detail: main.py uses Pipeline(stream_output=False), so the jobs' tqdm output is captured. You'll see the logs and the duration, but not the progress.
en.issue.no_venv.title: Virtual environment not found
en.issue.no_venv.detail: No virtual environment was found (venv-{name} or any folder with pyvenv.cfg and Scripts\python.exe), which holds the bot's Python and libraries. Create it from PowerShell with:
en.issue.no_lib.title: pi_kreton_rpa missing from the virtual environment
en.issue.no_lib.detail: The bot uses the team library, but it isn't installed in its venv.
en.issue.no_lib.install_whl: Install it with the .whl from common/lib.
